ICD-10 codes in HCUP CCSR categories

Source: R/ccsr.R
nis_ccsr_codes.Rd

Reads the official HCUP DXCCSR or PRCCSR reference file that you download yourself and returns the full ICD-10-CM or ICD-10-PCS codes assigned to the requested categories. Pass the result to nis_flag_dx() or nis_flag_pr(), which treat each code as a prefix. easyNIS does not ship or download any CCSR content, and the code lists depend on the reference file version you supply.

Usage

nis_ccsr_codes(file, categories, default_only = FALSE)

Arguments

file

Path to the HCUP CCSR reference file.

categories

Character vector of CCSR category codes, such as "CIR019". Matching ignores case.

default_only

If TRUE, keep only codes whose default inpatient category is in categories. Diagnosis reference files only.

Value

A sorted character vector of unique codes without periods.

Details

The reference file may be the HCUP Excel workbook (.xlsx, which needs the readxl package) or the HCUP comma-separated file. Excel files are read from the DX_to_CCSR_Mapping or PR_to_CCSR_Mapping sheet. Comma-separated files use the wide layout with CCSR CATEGORY 1, CCSR CATEGORY 2, and so on. A code mapped to a category in any of those columns is returned.

With default_only = TRUE, only codes whose default inpatient CCSR category is one of categories are returned. This matches the HCUP assignment of a single category to a principal diagnosis, so combine it with position = "principal" in nis_flag_dx(). Procedure reference files have no default assignment.

UNVERIFIED: the file layouts above are assumed from secondhand descriptions of HCUP downloads, not checked against a current release. The single-quoted CSV reader checks row field counts; all supported formats check that codes look like ICD-10 codes (3 to 7 letters or digits). Check the returned codes against your reference file before you rely on them.

This function is experimental.

See also

Defining cohorts.

Other cohort-definition: nis_attrition(), nis_audit_code_transition(), nis_dx_sensitivity(), nis_flag_dx(), nis_flag_dx_position(), nis_flag_pr(), nis_flag_pr_timing(), nis_prday_completeness()

Examples

# An invented reference file in the HCUP comma-separated layout. Download
# the real DXCCSR file from HCUP and pass its path instead.
reference <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
writeLines(c(
  "'ICD-10-CM CODE','CCSR CATEGORY 1','CCSR CATEGORY 2','DEFAULT CCSR CATEGORY IP'",
  "'I5022','CIR019','','CIR019'",
  "'I509','CIR019','','CIR019'",
  "'E119','END002','','END002'"
), reference)
codes <- nis_ccsr_codes(reference, "CIR019")
codes
#> [1] "I5022" "I509" 

nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019)) |>
  nis_flag_dx(heart_failure = codes) |>
  dplyr::count(heart_failure) |>
  dplyr::collect()
